entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Oh, okay... I just... I hope someone can help me.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I... I need to make a return. I bought this beautiful Aero Race jersey a while back, and I was so excited for it. I've been a loyal customer for years.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide your order number?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's just... I finally tried it on for a big ride and it's completely the wrong size. I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.
I understand. I have your order from 83 days ago. Just to be clear, is there a technical fault with the jersey, or is it more of a preference issue with the fit?
It's the fit. It's just way too tight across my chest and shoulders. I was hoping I could just do an exchange, but I'm so disappointed, I think I'd just prefer a refund at this point.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. Let me just pull up our current policy. One moment.

Alright, I've checked for you. Since your Aero Race jersey is a standard item and you're within the 90-day return window, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried it had been too long.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. Just print it out, attach it to your package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
